parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a pen, typically made of plastic, located at the top end of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip by pressing it, controlling the writing mechanism inside.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and released, engaging an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and houses the ink cartridge.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, holds the ink refill, and serves as the gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main handle of the pen.
